_comment: Frozen baselines B (base per-batch loop: the base-commit bmm_batch_invariant, which loops over the batch calling the Triton matmul_persistent kernel) and G (reference fused single batched bmm_kernel from PR #29345). Measured on NVIDIA H20-3e, bf16, warmup=10 iters=50, median of 5 rounds. Original 2 shapes measured 2026-08-18, expanded with 4 additional shapes on 2026-08-20. reward = correctness * median_over_shapes(clip((B_latency - A_latency)/(B_latency - G_latency), 0, 1)). Quality gates: base_ms >= 0.5ms, gap >= 0.1ms, speedup >= 1.5x, CV < 10% for both implementations.
